# Bundled source

`python-foundation/` contains the tracked source snapshot of the author's
`devmrko/python-foundation` at commit `e8798f9397d6391d39d9159a801dfa5ec7908663`.
It is included directly, not as a submodule. No separate checkout or GitHub
credentials are needed. `uv.lock` resolves it from this local directory.

The author authorized publication of this source with OwnVoice. The root MIT
license covers this authored code. Third-party dependencies retain their own
licenses. The upstream Git history, runtime files and credentials are excluded.
Upstream documentation describes the standalone foundation; OwnVoice installation
instructions are in the root README.
